title: BanglaAbuseMeme: A Dataset for Bengali Abusive Meme Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the dataset's gender representation using facial recognition (FairFace) to measure the distribution of victims in abusive versus non-abusive memes, and evaluating the predictive performance (accuracy, F1-score) and zero-shot capabilities of models on memes specifically targeting gender.
Evaluating the predictive performance (accuracy, F1-score) and zero-shot classification capabilities of multimodal models on abusive memes specifically targeting religious communities.

Evaluating the predictive performance (accuracy, F1-score) and zero-shot classification capabilities of multimodal models on abusive memes specifically targeting people based on their national origin.
Evaluating the predictive performance (accuracy, F1-score) and zero-shot classification capabilities of multimodal models on abusive memes specifically targeting political entities or figures.
Evaluating the predictive performance (accuracy, F1-score) and zero-shot classification capabilities of multimodal models on abusive memes specifically targeting various social sub-groups.
